title: Slice lane stack profile (stacks/<stack>/profile.json)
description: Fills the stack-neutral placeholders of the Slice lane core ({{test_command}}, {{static_analysis}}, {{boundary_check}}, {{standards_check}}, plus optional stack-specific keys). scripts/slice/gate.sh expands {{key}} in slice-method.json gate commands from 'placeholders'. A placeholder the profile does not define is a gate usage error, never an empty command.

static_analysis.description: Type checker / linter whose findings gate a merge.

boundary_check.description: Module/package dependency ratchet. Use 'true' and say so in the profile description when the stack has none.

standards_check.description: Standards ratchet (usually scripts/standards-check.sh {tree} with stack rules).

files.description: Adapter file (acef path) -> destination in the application.

checklist_commands.description: Stack commands for review-checklist items that need them.

metrics.description: Stack- or project-specific metrics inputs (paths config).

tool_error_patterns.description: Extra ERE patterns that mark a command counter's output as a tool error (e.g. the runtime's 'file not found' wording), on top of the core's 'command not found' and 'No such file or directory'.

requires.description: Commands that must run ('<cmd> --version' exits 0) for scripts/slice/selfcheck.sh to run this adapter's tests; otherwise the adapter is SKIPPED unless --stack <name> forces it.
